Fig. 08 — DeskDesk

drag anything

The whole site, spread out on the desk. Push things around; the desk remembers where you left them.

  • OrreryThe Sun, the planets and five stars, cut open and drawn by hand.
  • PlanisphereTonight's sky for your city, on a star wheel drawn in ink.
  • BarometerA brass weather station for your city, read every quarter hour.
  • ElementsAll 118, each with a spinning atom and one surprising fact.
  • GazetteA small newspaper: six short pieces on everyday science, each with a drawn infographic.

  • Pocket

Arrow keys move it, with Shift for bigger steps. R rotates it, open bracket sends it to the back, close bracket brings it to the front, and Shift F10 opens its menu.
